name.en: Fake courier text: “update your address” or “pay the redelivery fee”

how.en: A text that uses the name of PHLPost, J&T, LBC or another courier says your parcel could not be delivered because your address or barangay is incomplete, or that a small redelivery fee is due. The link opens a fake tracking page that asks for your details and card number or OTP. PHLPost and J&T say these texts are not from them and that you should track parcels only in their official apps or websites.

text.en: A text uses the name of PHLPost, J&T, LBC or another courier.
It says delivery failed because of a missing or wrong address, or is on hold.
It gives a link to update your details.
The site asks for a small redelivery fee by card, or for your OTP.
J&T Express: Your parcel is on hold, the barangay in your address is missing. Update within 24 hours to avoid return to sender: [link]

en: courier text saying my address is incomplete
phlpost text asking for a redelivery fee
j&t text to update my barangay with a link
parcel on hold text with a link
pay a small fee to redeliver my package
fake tracking site charged a redelivery fee
A delivery text with a link.
A small fee or card details to “redeliver”.
A foreign number or odd sender for a local courier.
Don’t tap the link. Track the parcel in the courier’s own app or website, or ask the seller.
If you entered card details, call your bank straight away.
Report the text to the CICC hotline 1326.
